title: Genomic analysis of non-NF2 meningiomas reveals mutations in TRAF7, KLF4, AKT1, and SMO [gene expression]

publications.title: Genomic analysis of non-NF2 meningiomas reveals mutations in TRAF7, KLF4, AKT1, and SMO.

processed_data_format: GSE58037_meningiomas.raw.txt.gz plus GSM-level normalized values (Detection Pval per probe)
needs_manual_review_reason: Live GEO verification (2026-07-11) confirms 114 GSM samples; Series_overall_design states 'Includes gene expression data from 75 unique meningiomas and 39 replicates', matching the discovery-log claim exactly (patient_count=75, sample_count=114). Publication PMID 23348505 (Clark et al., Science 2013, the Yale non-NF2 TRAF7/KLF4/AKT1/SMO genomic study) confirmed via PubMed esummary; this is the largest and most-cited record in this batch. Nine spot-checked GSM records (out of 114, not an exhaustive census) confirm genuine, rich per-sample metadata: sample title embeds the driver-mutation subtype directly (e.g. 'AKT1', 'AKT1+TRAF7', 'chr22loss', 'chr22loss+NF2', 'KLF4+TRAF7', 'SMO', 'unknown'), and characteristics fields include 'isprimary' (values seen: PRIMARY, Recurrent), 'grade' (values seen: 1, 2; grade 3 not yet observed in the spot-check but the paper covers all grades), and 'radiation' (values seen: No, Yes). Because only 9/114 samples were checked, grade_breakdown is deliberately left null rather than extrapolated from a small, non-random subset; a full per-sample pass across all 114 GSMs is recommended before this dataset is used for any grade-stratified analysis. molecular_subtype_annotated is set true on strong, directly-observed evidence (the mutation-group system is the paper's central named subtype classification). has_outcome_data and tags.recurrence_annotated are set true because the 'isprimary' field genuinely distinguishes primary vs. recurrent tumors at the sample level (not inferred from the abstract). treatment_timepoint_status includes 'primary'/'recurrent' (from isprimary) and 'treatment_naive' (interpreting 'radiation: No' as radiation-naive for that sample); radiation_timepoint tag was NOT set true because the 'radiation: Yes/No' field appears to record whether the patient ever received radiation therapy historically, not whether this specific tissue sample was collected pre- or post-radiation timepoint, and this interpretation should be double-checked by a human before being relied upon. large_cohort left false pending centralized quartile recomputation. AUTHOR-LIST COMPLETENESS FIX (2026-07-14 deep audit): publications[0].authors was truncated to the first 6 of the paper's actual 45 authors; expanded to the full list via the Europe PMC REST API authorString field (ASCII transliteration kept consistent with this record's existing style, e.g. Ozduman not Özduman). CORRESPONDING-AUTHOR RE-VERIFICATION (2026-07-14): corresponding_author 'Murat Gunel' was not merely assumed from last-author position -- a live web search cross-checking the Science journal's own correspondence footnote confirmed the paper's 'To whom correspondence should be addressed' email is murat.gunel@yale.edu, i.e. Günel M, matching the last-listed author. No change needed to corresponding_author.
